engine: transformers 5.23.0 + torch 2.11.0+cu128 (CUDA 12.8, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090), bf16, teacher-forced, reference PyTorch kernels for the Gated DeltaNet layers (no fla / causal_conv1d)
alignment: value i = activation at the position whose logits sampled generated token i (forward input = prompt + tokens[:-1]; i=0 is the last prompt token)
quantized: per-token series int8 (value = q*scale, |error| <= peak/254); heatmaps uint8 (value = q*scale, |error| <= peak/510)
